scenarios.name: Filter model browser entries by name

scenario_steps.name: a part with multiple work points and other features is open in the MCAD Software
the user opens the browser search field
matching work point rows are shown in the browser
the matching text is highlighted in those rows
unrelated visible feature rows are filtered from the browser
the model remains displayed in the viewport
the user activates the search field close control
the unfiltered browser tree is shown again
the user activates the close control again
the browser search field is hidden
